Image sources are own-property-selected committed local mapping entries, external links are literals, and SVG paths/styles derive from validated finite numeric values or fixed viewport numbers. Interpreter aliases are regex-escaped and issue strings remain text. The document CSP restricts script/connect/img to self with base-uri none, object-src none and no unsafe-eval. No controllable executing sink survives source review; no browser test was run.

local_checks.invariant: Attacker-controlled keys cannot recursively write prototypes and reach a security-relevant rendering, execution, authorization or navigation gadget.
local_checks.result: api.ts requires numeric keys for category maps, validates model ownership with Object.hasOwn, and shallow-spreads only parsed catalog data. Interpreter writes category keys through a fixed literal union and numeric filter keys from fixed field/relation enums. vehicle.ts and BrandLogo use Object.hasOwn for category/logo selection. App field writes originate from fixed VehicleEditor callbacks, while copies are shallow React state snapshots. No deep merge, dotted-path setter, __proto__/constructor/prototype assignment or other recursive untrusted-key write exists in the inspected input-to-render paths. Icon reads a fixed internal icon-name map. No prototype modification plus security-relevant gadget chain is present; JSON parsing and shallow copies alone do not establish pollution.
